items.a: Yes. The right question isn’t the size of the brand, but how clear the moment is: what needs to be told, to whom, and with what ambition.

items.q: Can we start with a single campaign?
items.a: Yes. A first campaign can be a clean testing ground: we learn quickly, keep what works and build what comes next with more precision.
No. We start from the idea, then bring together the right creators, the right formats, production and distribution. Influence gets stronger when it has real direction.
We look at what helps make decisions: attention, engagement, traffic, content reuse, cost per result and signal quality. Not only the numbers that look good.
Yes. When a piece of content deserves to last, you need to be able to reuse it easily: organically, in paid, on the right channels and at the right time.

items.q: This is our first influencer campaign. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. We set the framework with you, then move forward step by step: idea, talent, formats, production, distribution, reviewing the results.
